title: Tailwise Autoship Extension on Reissued Pals Rewards Certificates
content:
**Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus.** An Autoship extension is added to the validity of a certificate reissued after a return, according to the charged shipments that the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions carry dated in the last three months, all subscriptions counted together.

| Charged Tailwise Autoship shipments dated in the last three months | Autoship extension |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 4 days |
| 1 or 2 | 2 days |
| none | none |

**Edges (hypothetical).** 0 shipments: none. 1: 2 days. 2: 2 days. 3: 4 days.
